sentence: This project builds a system that uses unmanned aircraft with visual and olfactory sensors to find wildfires early.
This project studies how electric fields change the magnetic behavior of adaptive materials using ionic transport and elastic strain.
This project builds computer models that combine machine learning with multiscale models to predict how diseases progress and how drugs interact with the body.
This project builds an online platform with hands-on exercises for using cyberinfrastructure and artificial intelligence in environmental science.
This project develops quantum computing methods to model transportation networks under uncertainty and to solve routing problems.
This project tries to find out whether single-layer strontium ruthenate is a spin-triplet or a spin singlet superconductor.
This project designs learning models that use wireless domain knowledge to make attacks and countermeasures in wireless network security more efficient.
This project studies how heatwaves change the way bacteria and yeasts compete in flower nectar and how that affects hummingbirds and plants.
This project studies how artificial intelligence and machine learning can help make Internet of Things systems more secure.
This project builds an open-source ecosystem around a free tool that makes chip design faster and cheaper.
This project builds sensors that combine DNA nanotechnology with electronics to detect early signs of disease in blood.
This project builds a framework that recognizes the daily activities of people in indoor videos.
This project studies how social and ecological factors shape why males gather to perform displays for mating in white-bearded manakins.
This project develops workshops about security and privacy risks in artificial intelligence systems.
This project uses a multibeam sonar to collect bathymetric data in oceans and lakes and to map coral reefs.
This project builds AI systems that learn how people use objects with parts that can be manipulated, such as cabinets with doors, from video.
This project studies how African lungfish remodel their skin between water and land and how a toxin affects goblet cells.
This project uses theory and computational methods to study the electronic and magnetic properties of frustrated magnets.
This project studies how motor proteins in the cytoskeleton work together and generate force in different environments.
This project builds artificial intelligence methods that explain decisions by learning patterns in data that people can understand.
